scope: Read-only documentary review of chapter5.1–5.3 and5.5 against guidepp21–27; no models, empirical tests or project market/test data.

findings.correction: Specify the model ranking score as the mean of per-run pooled-date RMSEs, not RMSE pooled across seeds/dates or an ensemble RMSE.
No principal D is selected; report baseline by comparable configuration or freeze a global D-selection rule using development.
Best/worst identities can differ by RMSE and MAE; define references per metric or explicitly keep RMSE-ranking identities.
A ratio of per-run mean metrics differs from the mean of per-seed ratios; fix and label the estimand.
Test-selected extremes are data-dependent descriptive references; they are not the frozen development-selected baseline or automatic a-priori inferential contrasts.
Name paired Cohen dz, orient its sign and use paired-difference standard deviation. Do not replace matched effects with independent marginal Cliff comparisons.
Point-estimate Pareto dominance is descriptive and does not establish population dominance; error-time and error-parameter fronts need explicit dimensions and measurement conditions.
A future advanced-versus-baseline MDE requires the variance/covariance of paired differences, not baseline-only SD or CI. Its practical margin is not the accepted persistence5percent criterion.
The literature gap has already been quantified descriptively in section3.4.1; only a transferable local margin remains unestablished.
Keep the same development-frozen baseline when reporting2025 and2026; do not retrospectively choose a different baseline in each test period.

literature_values_scope: Already documented descriptive reductions from rounded author means; not new model results or a transferable E1 threshold.
